high_level_description: The image depicts a small, rustic wooden stool placed on a tiled floor. The stool has a natural, unfinished wood finish with visible grain patterns, giving it a warm and earthy appearance. It features four sturdy legs that are slightly angled outward for stability. On top of the stool sits a clear glass vase containing a single stem with two white flowers, adding a touch of elegance and freshness to the scene. The background is minimalistic, with a plain, light-colored wall that provides a neutral backdrop, allowing the stool and its contents to stand out.
